heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Effect of probate.
article.content: Probate of a will when granted establishes the will from the death of the testator, and renders valid all intermediate acts of the executor as such.
article.html:
227Effect of probate.

Section 227 · Part IX · Chapter I · page 70 of the Act

Probate of a will when granted establishes the will from the death of the testator, and renders valid all intermediate acts of the executor as such.
